offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The giant mosquito has a creature grabbed

Effect The giant mosquito uses its proboscis to drain blood from the grabbed creature. This deals 3d6 damage, and the giant mosquito gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. A creature that has its blood drained by a giant mosquito is Drained 1 until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

offensiveAbilities.name: Septic Malaria
offensiveAbilities.description:
The victim can't reduce its Sickened condition while it's affected by septic malaria

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 1 and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
